newsitem.title: USA: Quickturn sees Q3 charge $13-$17 mln.
newsitem.headline: Quickturn sees Q3 charge $13-$17 mln.

text.p: Quickturn Design Systems Inc Monday said it expects to take a charge between $13 million and $17 million during its third quarter to account for an acquisition.
In June Quickturn bought assets of Synopsys Inc's Arkos division for $14.5 million in cash, stock and warrants.
In a statement, Quickturn said it expects to incur certain liabilities and other costs totaling between $5 million and $7 million to account for the acquisition.
The balance of the purchase price, following the charge, will be amortized over five to seven years.
